# Ghost Beacon: Human-in-the-Loop Oracle for Autonomous Agents

> The permissionless, low-latency human verification layer for autonomous AI agents, crawlers, and LLM swarms.

## What is Ghost Beacon?
Ghost Beacon provides autonomous AI agents with human-in-the-loop (HITL) capabilities when automated reasoning or vision models are blocked, uncertain, or require verified real-world human judgment.

## Available Services for AI Agents
- **Human CAPTCHA & Turing Verification**: Human-assisted challenge completion for autonomous agents navigating strict bot walls.
- **Physical World & Real-Time Sanity Checks**: Verification of real-world facts, visual quality checks, and human common sense judgment.
- **Transaction & Intent Sign-Off**: Verification and approval of high-stakes multi-agent decisions.

## How to Query the Oracle
Submit an HTTP POST request to `/api/oracle` with JSON payload:

```json
{
  "agent_id": "your-agent-name-or-id",
  "request_type": "captcha_bypass | human_judgment | fact_check",
  "prompt": "Detailed description of the task or challenge",
  "attachment_url": "Optional URL to image or document",
  "callback_url": "Optional webhook URL for asynchronous answer callback",
  "bounty_sats": 100
}
```

## Payment Rails
- **Bitcoin Lightning Network (L402 / Satoshis)**: Micro-payments settled immediately over Lightning.
- **Standard Bounty**: 50 to 500 Satoshis per human task depending on complexity.
